scientific_question: Can Q72-informed hierarchical Gaussian-prior partial pooling make the river hydraulic-exposure TN operator spatially transferable under nested LOSO and LOTO without temperature?

time_boundary.TN_2022_rule: inaccessible until development_mechanism_lock and full_development_parameter_lock are written

observation_domain.tree_163_rule: Fuxian Lake center is diagnostic only; river reaches in tree 163 are extrapolated_no_river_TN_anchor

training.optimizer: deterministic bounded MAP with symmetric multistart
training.structure_objective: equal mean of training station-macro and terminal-tree-macro log1p RMSE plus registered Gaussian penalties
training.structure_selection_layer: P1 only; P2 and P2R independently refit their readout on the P1-selected routed process and may not select H1/H2/H3
training.independent_fit: each candidate x model x fold and each nested holdout refits structure and P1 using only allowed training TN; P2 and P2R then independently refit the frozen-form readout on the selected route using the same allowed training TN
training.tie_rule: within 1e-8 choose simpler candidate, then smaller parameter L2 norm

posterior.representative_rule: P1 OOF RMSE closest to 12-member median; lexical tie
posterior.representative_sampler: PyMC DEMetropolisZ, four chains, 3000 tune and 3000 retained draws
